tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo'i zur 'debs bzhugs so// rje btsun ma sgrol ma dkar mo'i cho ga la/ ngag 'don rnams rje dkon mchog lhun grub kyi yig cha gzhir bzhag de la rnal 'byor pa mang po tshogs pa'i cho ga byed tshe/ chos rje bla ma dam pa sogs kyis yig cha dang / mthong brgyud kyi phyag len tho la/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ sbyor ba'i skabs su gnas khang byi dor byas par/ 'byor na mchog gsum spyi dang khyad par rje btsun ma'i bris 'bur gyi sku rten sogs dar zab sogs kyi na bza' dang bcas bkod pa mdzes par bshams pa dang / bla bre yol ba sogs kyis mchod rdzas kyang gang 'byor bshams/ de rnams gtan nas ma 'byor na chad pa'i skyon ni med do/ /de lta bu'i rten gyi drung du maṇḍal khru gang pa padma 'dab brgyad bris pa'i dbus su tshom bu dkar po bkod par bshams/ de'i byang shar nas mtshams 'dzin me tog nas bzung ste chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod rnams g.yas bskor du bshams/ byang shar nas shar lho'i bar du zlum gtor gsum dang bgegs gtor rnams lag len bzhin bsham ste/ dmigs bsal ni/ gtor ma dang po 'das gtor te yi dam sgrol ma la yin/ gnyis pa phyogs skyong / gsum pa 'byung po/ bzhi pa bgegs gtor ni bgegs rigs la ster rgyu'o/ /slob dpon gyi mdun du lcog rtse sogs ji ltar rigs pa'i stegs la/ bum pa kha rgyan gzung rdor gos bzung rdo rje dril bu me tog sogs dang / rnal 'byor pa gzhan rnams kyi mdun du'ang rdor dril dang gos bzung dang / rnga sil dung sogs mchod pa'i yo byad ci 'byor bsham mo/ /dngos gzhi ni rten gyi gang zag 'di'i rjes gnang thob cing bsnyen pa song bas sha chang sgog tsong sogs spangs shing khrus sogs gtsang sbra dang bcas gdan la 'khod de/ nges 'byung gi blo dang gzhan phan byang sems sngon du btang nas/ sngags dang phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin dang bcas/

mchod rdzas yakṣas bsang bas bzung ste mchod pa'i byin rlabs dharma ra ni rol chen dang bcas byin dbab bo/ /bdag bskyed ni skyabs 'gro sems bskyed nas gzungs te mjug gi mchod bstod gsol btab kyi bar dkyus bzhin las/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas gdan 'od zer gyi rnam par gyur te rang la thim zhes brjod de/ mdun bskyed maṇḍal bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las padma sogs nas sa ma ya dzaḥ'i rang nyid ces pa dor ba tsam ma gtogs bdag bskyed bzhin brjod/ de nas spos dang rdor dril 'dzin pas/ ma lus sems mgon ma dang / spro na/ chos rnams kun gyi dbang phyug sogs dang / de nas bcom ldan 'dir ni sogs nas/ padma ka ma ya satwaṃ gyi bar dang puṣpe sogs kyis mchod/ oṃ badzra aṃ ku sha sogs kyi dgug gzhug bya/ slar yang thugs kha'i sogs nas 'od dpag med kyi dbu brgyan pa'i bar mchod pa bsangs sbyangs byin gyi rlabs dharma ra ṇi brjod mi dgos la rab 'byams rgya mtsho ma'am mchod yon phal cher ma gang rung dang / oṃ sarba bid pu ra sogs nas sparṣe kā ma gu ṇa'i bar rgyal srid sna bdun dang 'dod yon lnga rnams yo ga ltar dbul/ rdor dril 'dzin pas/ bstod pa 'khor ba las sgrol sogs dang / gzhan yang rgya gzhung bod gzhung gang shes rnams kyis bstod/ bum pa bsangs sbyangs sogs dkyus bzhin las 'khor lo gsal btab nas/ rang gi snying kha nas sngags kyi phreng ba gzung thag la rten nas song bas bum nang gi lha'i thugs khar phog pas thugs brgyud bskul ste/ 'khor lo dang sku las sogs 'dra/ gtor ma rnams chab kyi bran te bsang sbyangs/ dang po yi dam sgrol ma la dbul/ gzhan rnams cha gsum gyi cho gas gtang ngo / /mdun bskyed kyi thugs khar gsal btab ste/ bzlas pa stong phrag sogs bya/ spro na/ bzlas pa'i mjug tu'ang mchod bstod 'dod don gsol btab bya/ khrus chog byed na lha'i mtshan dang sngags 'don pa bsgyur ba tsam ma gtogs tshe dpag med dang /

rnam 'joms gang rung ltar bya/ rjes chog kha gsos byin gyis brlab pa sogs dkyus ltar las/ zhag grangs mang po byed na nyi ma snga ma rnams la rdul tshon la brtan bzhugs dang / rjes ma'i nyin gshegs gsol bya mjug tu bkra shis/ ston mchog dam pa'am che ba'i che mchog rgyas pa dang / gzhan yang bsngo ba smon lam rgyud 'debs sogs bya zhing 'khor gsum rnam par dag pa'i rgyas gdab bo/ /'di ni cung zad rgyas pa'i dbang du byas pa yin la/ bsdu na mdun bskyed bum pa la bsdu ba dkyus bzhin no/ /maṅga laṃ/ 'di yang dad ldan rnams la phan pa'i phyir buddha lakṣ+mis e waṃ dharman ru sbyar ba'o// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo'i zur 'debs/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 3
